  "cells": [
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "# Human Activity Recognition using PCA and LDA\n",
        "## 1. Data Preparation and Preprocessing\n",
        "In this section, we mount Google Drive, load the training and testing datasets, and combine them to perform consistent feature scaling (Standardization)."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "9UC41Y9XtFP6"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        "from google.colab import drive\n",
        "\n",
        "drive.mount('/content/drive')\n",
        "\n",
        "base_path = \"/content/drive/MyDrive/\"\n",
        "\n",
        "features_path = base_path + \"features.txt\"\n",
        "activity_labels_path = base_path + \"activity_labels.txt\"\n",
        "\n",
        "activity_labels = pd.read_csv(activity_labels_path, sep=r\"\\s+\", header=None, names=[\"id\", \"activity\"])\n",
        "features = pd.read_csv(features_path, sep=r\"\\s+\", header=None)\n",
        "feature_names = [f\"{name}_{i}\" for i, name in enumerate(features[1].values)]\n",
        "\n",
        "X_train = pd.read_csv(base_path + \"X_train.txt\", sep=r\"\\s+\", header=None, names=feature_names)\n",
        "X_test = pd.read_csv(base_path + \"X_test.txt\", sep=r\"\\s+\", header=None, names=feature_names)\n",
        "y_train = pd.read_csv(base_path + \"y_train.txt\", sep=r\"\\s+\", header=None, names=[\"Activity\"])\n",
        "y_test = pd.read_csv(base_path + \"y_test.txt\", sep=r\"\\s+\", header=None, names=[\"Activity\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "X = pd.concat([X_train, X_test], axis=0)\n",
        "y = pd.concat([y_train, y_test], axis=0).values.ravel()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"Full Dataset Shape: {X.shape}\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "dD-00jgKtGbK",
        "outputId": "f903ffec-f824-4418-bf08-d8b069fd230c"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Drive already mounted at /content/drive; to attempt to forcibly remount, call drive.mount(\"/content/drive\", force_remount=True).\n",
            "Full Dataset Shape: (10299, 561)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## 2. Feature Scaling\n",
        "We apply 'StandardScaler` to normalize the feature space, ensuring all features contribute equally before applying dimensionality reduction."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "FDw3ArBktbo7"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "scaler = StandardScaler()\n",
        "X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)\n",
        "\n",
        "X_train_scaled = X_scaled[:len(X_train)]\n",
        "X_test_scaled = X_scaled[len(X_train):]\n",
        "y_train_split = y[:len(y_train)]\n",
        "y_test_split = y[len(y_train):]"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "tA0mQjActcIk"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## 3. Unsupervised Dimensionality Reduction: PCA\n",
        "We apply Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to find the minimum number of components needed to preserve at least 90% of the total variance."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "h4RPswDCtnvB"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.decomposition import PCA\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "# Fit full PCA\n",
        "pca_full = PCA()\n",
        "pca_full.fit(X_train_scaled)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Cumulative explained variance\n",
        "cumulative_variance = np.cumsum(pca_full.explained_variance_ratio_)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Find components for 90% variance\n",
        "n_components_90 = np.argmax(cumulative_variance >= 0.90) + 1\n",
        "print(f\"Number of components required for 90% variance: {n_components_90}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Apply PCA with selected components\n",
        "pca = PCA(n_components=n_components_90)\n",
        "X_train_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_train_scaled)\n",
        "X_test_pca = pca.transform(X_test_scaled)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"PCA Reduced Train Shape: {X_train_pca.shape}\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "PJe8z6qfvvD7",
        "outputId": "913f0814-d17e-4b6d-80f2-da802b867f3a"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Number of components required for 90% variance: 63\n",
            "PCA Reduced Train Shape: (7352, 63)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "### Visualizing the first two Principal Components (PCA)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "D8bkU09wtx7V"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))\n",
        "scatter = plt.scatter(X_train_pca[:, 0], X_train_pca[:, 1], c=y_train_split, cmap='jet', s=5)\n",
        "plt.title(\"PCA Projection (First Two Components)\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"PC1\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"PC2\")\n",
        "plt.colorbar(scatter, label=\"Activity Class\")\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "sviLRGSDtzE-",
        "outputId": "c6b1aca3-de87-4f5a-cd02-8e79026ca425",
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 198
        }
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<Figure size 800x600 with 2 Axes>"
            ],
            "image/png": "\n"
          },
          "metadata": {}
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## 4. Supervised Dimensionality Reduction: LDA\n",
        "Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) maximizes class separability using class labels. We reduce the dimensions to C - 1 where C is the number of unique classes."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "SHcPNG5Wt3Lh"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis as LDA\n",
        "\n",
        "num_classes = len(np.unique(y_train_split))\n",
        "n_lda_components = num_classes - 1\n",
        "print(f\"Number of classes: {num_classes}, reducing LDA to {n_lda_components} dimensions.\")\n",
        "\n",
        "lda = LDA(n_components=n_lda_components)\n",
        "X_train_lda = lda.fit_transform(X_train_scaled, y_train_split)\n",
        "X_test_lda = lda.transform(X_test_scaled)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"LDA Reduced Train Shape: {X_train_lda.shape}\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "2s2fX8oit2O4",
        "outputId": "da44e5dd-e693-4283-ef8a-c56ade6157c0",
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        }
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Number of classes: 6, reducing LDA to 5 dimensions.\n",
            "LDA Reduced Train Shape: (7352, 5)\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "### Visualizing the first two LDA Components"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "1VctFC08t753"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))\n",
        "scatter = plt.scatter(X_train_lda[:, 0], X_train_lda[:, 1], c=y_train_split, cmap='jet', s=5)\n",
        "plt.title(\"LDA Projection (First Two Components)\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"LD1\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"LD2\")\n",
        "plt.colorbar(scatter, label=\"Activity Class\")\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "DInEYmQLt9IZ",
        "outputId": "b4f2bff6-4ee3-4445-ebf1-47fa56935901",
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 198
        }
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<Figure size 800x600 with 2 Axes>"
            ],
            "image/png": "\n"
          },
          "metadata": {}
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## 5. Classification and Evaluation\n",
        "We train a Logistic Regression model twice: once using the **PCA-reduced features** and once using the **LDA-reduced features** to compare their performance."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "SEWeWAmSuAZr"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "Vvbi0gTKvU4t"
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "model_pca = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)\n",
        "model_pca.fit(X_train_pca, y_train_split)\n",
        "y_pred_pca = model_pca.predict(X_test_pca)\n",
        "\n",
        "metrics_pca = {\n",
        "    \"Accuracy\": accuracy_score(y_test_split, y_pred_pca),\n",
        "    \"Precision\": precision_score(y_test_split, y_pred_pca, average='weighted'),\n",
        "    \"Recall\": recall_score(y_test_split, y_pred_pca, average='weighted'),\n",
        "    \"F1-Score\": f1_score(y_test_split, y_pred_pca, average='weighted')\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "print(metrics_pca)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "xMhzJviKvPaH",
        "outputId": "f1d02a80-57d7-42bb-bb46-101800edbdea",
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        }
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "{'Accuracy': 0.9222938581608415, 'Precision': 0.9225985025254402, 'Recall': 0.9222938581608415, 'F1-Score': 0.9222709652458769}\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "model_lda = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)\n",
        "model_lda.fit(X_train_lda, y_train_split)\n",
        "y_pred_lda = model_lda.predict(X_test_lda)\n",
        "\n",
        "metrics_lda = {\n",
        "    \"Accuracy\": accuracy_score(y_test_split, y_pred_lda),\n",
        "    \"Precision\": precision_score(y_test_split, y_pred_lda, average='weighted'),\n",
        "    \"Recall\": recall_score(y_test_split, y_pred_lda, average='weighted'),\n",
        "    \"F1-Score\": f1_score(y_test_split, y_pred_lda, average='weighted')\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "print(metrics_lda)"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "-WU435TpvHAB",
        "outputId": "819b903d-d2b5-4e03-bc31-483c8e9ac045",
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        }
      },
      "execution_count": null,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "{'Accuracy': 0.9650492025788938, 'Precision': 0.9659735968033579, 'Recall': 0.9650492025788938, 'F1-Score': 0.9649518722726325}\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "## 6. Performance Comparison\n",
        "Let's look at the numerical table comparing PCA and LDA performance metrics."

      "source": [
        "## 7. Discussion and Interpretation of Results\n",
        "* **PCA Approach:** PCA is an unsupervised technique that aims to maximize the variance explained. By choosing 65 components, we kept 90% of the variance and achieved high classification scores because the structural information was preserved.\n",
        "* **LDA Approach:** LDA is a supervised technique focused on maximizing class separability. Even though it compressed the data down to only 5 components (C-1), it still achieved excellent classification performance, proving that using class labels significantly helps in keeping relevant discriminatory information."
      ],
